name: In Eranikus' Own Words
summary: Itharius seeks Eranikus' voice through the gem. Eranikus lies between sleep and death, caught in nightmares. The essence you gave is badly tainted, yet hope remains. Itharius sends you to eastern Winterspring.

sections.title: A Voice Across the Nightmare
sections.body: Itharius says Eranikus lies between sleep and death, caught in a weave of nightmares. The essence you gave is badly tainted, yet there may be a way to reach him. To speak through the gem, Itharius sends you to eastern Winterspring to seek one of his mortal allies.

sections.title: The Spiritspeaker
sections.body: Umbranse the Spiritspeaker is the ally Itharius has in mind. Umbranse is a human who acts as a medium for the dead. Eranikus is not truly dead, but Itharius believes Umbranse may still help.

sections.title: Umbranse's Condition
sections.body:
Umbranse says Itharius was wise to send you. Eranikus will soon offer counsel in his own words. For now, Umbranse cannot help directly, but will lend skill at death-speaking.

First, Umbranse needs help from someone not held back by age. The most potent augury device in Umbranse's keeping was taken against Umbranse's will. Without it, Eranikus cannot be helped.

faq.q: Who sends you on this journey?
aliases: who gives in eranikus own words
faq.answer: Itharius sends you from the Swamp of Sorrows after taking the tainted essence of Eranikus from you.
Umbranse the Spiritspeaker is a human medium for the dead and one of Itharius' mortal allies. Umbranse is in eastern Winterspring.
Eranikus is not truly dead. He lies between sleep and death, caught in a weave of nightmares.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the storyline?
aliases: what came before in eranikus own words
faq.answer: This follows the second step of The Essence of Eranikus, when you gave Itharius the gem holding what remained of Eranikus' free will.
